name: @gjsify/webrtc-native-darwin-arm64
description: darwin-arm64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/webrtc-native. Installed automatically on darwin/arm64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.darwin-arm64: prebuilds.yml's `build-prebuilds-macos` job builds and load-tests it; `commit-prebuilds` lands the first artifact on main after the macOS promotion merges
